sources: [S1] ASRO (Asociația de Standardizare din România) — SR EN ISO 22400, SR EN 13306
[S2] Senior Software / SeniorXRP — major Romanian ERP/MES vendor
[S4] Microsoft Romanian Localization Style Guide — formal 'dumneavoastră'
[S5] terms.json — Romanian translations analyzed for consistency validation

falseFriends.eventually: Use 'în cele din urmă', not 'eventual' (which means 'possibly')
falseFriends.assist: Use 'ajuta', not 'asista' (which means 'to attend a meeting')
falseFriends.performance: 'Performanță' IS correct for OEE in Romanian, but also means 'high achievement' — context clarifies
falseFriends.station: Use 'stație de lucru' for workstation; 'stație' alone means bus/train station
falseFriends.scrap: Use 'rebuturi' for production defects; 'deșeuri' means general waste/garbage
falseFriends.shift: 'Schimb' correctly means work shift AND exchange — unambiguous in manufacturing
falseFriends.demand: Use 'cerere de producție' for production demand

grammarNotes.genderAndCase: Three genders (m, f, neuter). 5 cases. Articles suffixed: 'disponibilitate' → 'disponibilitatea'.
grammarNotes.postposedArticle: Definite article is postposed: 'mașina' (the machine). UI labels often use bare nouns.
grammarNotes.numberFormatting: Comma decimal, period thousands: '1.234,56'. Acronyms: 'OEE-ul' (the OEE) with hyphen.
grammarNotes.genitiveConstruction: Genitive for compound terms: 'timp de ciclu' (cycle time), 'motiv de oprire' (stop reason)
grammarNotes.diacritics: Mandatory: ș (s-comma), ț (t-comma), ă, â, î. 'Performanță' not 'performanta'.
grammarNotes.compoundPluralModifiers: In prepositional compound phrases with 'de', the modifier noun stays SINGULAR when naming a concept/category. CORRECT: 'motive de pierdere de viteză' (reasons of loss [sg] of speed). WRONG: 'motive de pierderi de viteză' ('pierderi' is plural). The modifier names the category of speed loss; only the head noun takes plural.

industryContext.oeeTerminology: OEE is commonly used. Full Romanian term: 'Eficiența Globală a Echipamentelor' (EGE).
industryContext.dominantSectors: Automotive (Dacia/Renault, Ford), electronics (Bosch Blaj), textiles, food, pharma
industryContext.seniorSoftware: Senior Software / SeniorXRP is dominant Romanian ERP — their terminology carries significant weight.

commonMistakes: Using 'actual' for measured values instead of 'real' or 'efectiv'
Using 'deșeuri' for manufacturing scrap instead of 'rebuturi'
Omitting hyphen in OEE-ul/KPI-ul when grammar requires definite article
Using 'mentenanță' vs 'întreținere' inconsistently — use 'mentenanță' per SR EN 13306

Pluralizing the modifier in compound noun phrases: 'motive de pierderi de viteză' (WRONG — 'pierderi' is plural) instead of 'motive de pierdere de viteză' (CORRECT — 'pierdere' stays singular as it names the concept). Only the head noun should take plural
notes: OEE is used; formal 'dumneavoastră'. Romanian is Romance with Slavic influences and postposed article. P95 expansion 2.00x. Mandatory diacritics.
